maul--collective-ambition.text: Action [Exhaust]: Choose a unit. If it has more different keywords than it has Experience tokens on it, give an Experience token to it and deal 1 damage to it.
maul--collective-ambition.epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 7 or more resources, deploy this leader.
maul--collective-ambition.deployBox: When Deployed/On Attack: Choose a unit. If it has more different keywords than it has Experience tokens on it, give an Experience token to it and deal 1 damage to it.
maul--collective-ambition.officialRules:
Multiple instances of the same keyword aren't considered different keywords, including for stacking keywords like Raid X.
The chosen unit gets the Experience token and is dealt 1 damage simultaneously, so it will survive if it has 1 remaining HP.
